normalization: Sharp: preserve body square canvas, alpha-bounds crop standalone ornaments and one eye; resize 800px body / max400px ornaments, WebP quality90 alpha100. No generated background removal or geometry painting.
locks: One front camera, upper-left light, blank facial surface, round body and short nubs, stable percentage anchors. Face and ornaments never receive the skin filter; charcoal and white keep lilac antenna.

prompts.body: Reference base-lavender.webp. Production transparent character sprite retaining round egg-shaped body, two rounded side nubs, tiny feet, antenna leaning right with round ball. Premium soft satin clay, broad smooth surfaces, no texture, subtle broad upper-left light, minimal highlights. Reduce hands/feet 35%. Pale lavender #e9e1ff to #bbace9, antenna lilac with soft cyan highlight. Completely blank face for separate animated eyes. Orthographic straight front, square transparent canvas. No ground, shadow, orbit, pedestal, accessories, text or background.
prompts.eye: Single pair of identical vertical black oval eyes, front view, black satin with small soft upper-left white highlight, rounded ends. Transparent with no face, brows, mouth, lashes, shadows or background. Split and normalize one eye for symmetric placement.
prompts.smile: Single softly curved inverted U closed-eye arc, black rounded thick curve with downward ends and subtle satin highlight. Smooth clay, simple and legible. Transparent, no eyeball/face/background/text/other marks.
prompts.commonAccessory: Production dress-up accessory for referenced Hermes. Only accessory, no body. Orthographic front, centered transparent square. Premium smooth satin clay, broad soft upper-left light, simple shapes, restrained highlights. No textile/seam/photoreal details, text, outline, pedestal, ground or cast shadow.
prompts.beret: Compact rounded warm coral #eda28e beret tilted left, tiny nub, no antenna hole, three soft volumes.
prompts.headphones: Small ivory headphones, thin horseshoe band with completely empty transparent opening, muted mint cups, no cable or microphone.
prompts.star: Rounded butter-yellow #f4cf75 five-point star badge, subtle dimensional bevel; no face/pin fitting/extra sparkle.
prompts.moon: Soft sky-blue #a5c9ed crescent badge, rounded tips, broad bevel, no face/stars/string.
prompts.orbit: Small horizontal pale-gold #ebce8b elliptical thin tube, wide transparent opening, one small cream sphere on right; no planet/antenna/body.
prompts.wings: Symmetric pair of milky ivory/lilac wings with large transparent gap, each wing three rounded feather lobes, front view, no fine texture, body or bird.
